title: SmtpRelayError missing #[non_exhaustive]
description: SmtpRelayError is a public enum in the stoa-smtp library crate (has [lib] in Cargo.toml). Without #[non_exhaustive], adding a new variant is a breaking change — downstream code doing exhaustive match on SmtpRelayError will fail to compile. The test all_variants_classified already acknowledges the exhaustiveness concern (the comment says it will fail to compile if new variants are added). That concern is exactly why #[non_exhaustive] exists: it lets the crate add variants without a semver major bump.
